$comment: THE RATIFIED CEILING, KEPT AS A WARNING (the WO-29 follow-up ruling).
One catch-all entry per profile, deliberately not one per state: runner CPU drift is a
property of the hardware, not of any route. LHCI evaluates EVERY matrix entry whose
pattern matches (@lhci/utils/src/assertions.js loops the whole matrix per URL), which is
how one audit carries two levels: `error` at the runner ceiling in the entries above,
`warn` at 04 §8.2's ratified number here. The warn row never fails a run -- it keeps the
real budget in every nightly summary, so drift toward it is visible long before it
becomes a regression, and the ratified number is never quietly deleted from the file.
